title: Mixed Event — Time to hang out♪

meta.Outline: Upon hearing Minori's eagerness to ask An what it was like growing up with Haruka, Kohane suggests a day out for the four of them. On the day of, both Minori and Kohane learn the true depth of An and Haruka's friendship...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I should be all set for class...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But I got to school so early today.
Minori hasn't even arrived yet...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
We're supposed to start practicing a new song after school today, so I should listen to it while I can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, that's really cool...
If it were up to me, I might sing the chorus like...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, that didn't sound right.
It needs to start off stronger...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, that's much better...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And if I'm doing a solo, it needs to be more...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good morning, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, good morning!
You seem pretty excited today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's because we're having a meeting to discuss stream ideas today! I've really been looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Were you listening to some music just now, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My team and I are gonna be practicing a new song later today and wanted to hear what it was like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
You guys are such amazing singers too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your teammates even pointed out what I needed to work on for the Fan Festival so quickly without hesitation!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. They really are amazing.
I wouldn't be where I am without them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know what you mean!
Oh, also... Was it Shiraishi?
You know, Haruka's childhood friend...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. She did mention that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so jealous. She knows what Haruka was like when she was little... I wonder what she was like... Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I promised to ask more about Haruka from back then, but completely missed my opportunity...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I lost my chance to learn more about the Haruka I know nothing about...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, then... Wanna go ask An later?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, no, I couldn't...!
I'd be interrupting your practice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's okay. You can ask her when we're taking a break or something. An and I have even been talking about us all hanging out together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Plus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to know more about An from back then too...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, I'm sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll ask An about when she's free to hang out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
I'll make sure to ask Haruka too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I have an idea!
What if we all went to...?
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of us, including An?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Kohane and I were talking about how we should all hang out together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How does shopping, grabbing something to eat and going to see the night show at PXL to cap it all off sound?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, that sounds super fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it does. I'm sure you'll have a wonderful time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. It's good to hang out and have fun with friends every so often, so I say go for it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And PXL's night shows have been blowing up online, so it might be a good learning experience too, no?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? They're that amazing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The effects they use are apparently so spectacular that some TV shows have been visiting to film entire segments about them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And everyone's been talking about how they change what they do each day, so you can never get tired of these shows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that does sound amazing♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?! Kohane even told me about how they had a big Miku hologram appear during their very first show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: According to her, it was a surprise addition and the park went absolutely wild after that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's wonderful♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And it really would be a good learning experience to see something like that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I promise to tell you all about it after we see it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, um... Haruka, if you're free...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd love to. It sounds like a lot of fun. I still haven't seen one of their night shows yet, so I've been meaning to go...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But is it really okay for us to go...? I mean, we have our next stream to worry about, and I was hoping to get some more practice in along with coming up with more ideas...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Haruka.
You're still in idol mode.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's right. It's important to take breaks, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You work so hard every day for us, so please, relax and enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm with her on this. We'll take care of any new ideas for our stream, so go have fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you, everyone...
In that case, I think I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And thanks for inviting me, Minori.
Can I RSVP right now...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, of course...!
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Practice went great today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it did!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An, before I forget.
Are you free this Sunday?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
This Sunday?
Sure, but why?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori and I were wondering if you and Kiritani would be free to hang out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori seemed so sad about not being able to ask you more about Kiritani, so we thought that it'd be nice if we could hang out and go somewhere together...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally forgot!
I was having too much fun practicing with Minori and her friends that time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But she really likes Haruka, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, she does.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And Haruka feels the same way about her.
Hehe. I can't help but smile...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go! The four of us!
I can't wait to see them again!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An!
Then, I'll see you Sunday!
The day of
Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait!
I had to help get our place ready to open.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's okay.
We just got here a second ago.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank goodness!
Anyway, I've really been looking forward to today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, me too, Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, call me An.
I mean, we're here to have fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A-Are you sure?
I guess, um... An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Much better!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While we're at it, Azusawa, why don't we call each other on a first-name basis too...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sure!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh?! R-Right...!
Thank you too, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Are you blushing, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I mean...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know exactly how you feel, Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka's really cool and really cute on top of that...! I'm used to it now, but my heart raced the first time she called me by my first name.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that true?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So that means Kohane's heart must be pounding right now right...?
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh? Is that jealousy I'm sensing, An?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, it's not jealousy...
It's just, my singing should be the only thing that makes Kohane feel this way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An, you're crushing me...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're so close.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They really are.
Well, An's always been the friendly type, but this is the first time I've seen her be this close with someone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course we're close!
She's my partner!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, let's have as much fun as we can today, so shall we?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, this coat's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You'd look great in it, Minori...!
This cardigan's really cute too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
I can't decide. Everything this store has is so adorable...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This place is full of clothes that suit the both of you, Minori, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Oh, Minori, this blouse might look really good on you. Here, try it on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Sure, like this?
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it suits you really well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Thank you so much, Haruka...!
I'm gonna go take these up front!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome, but just like that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why not? I like your style, Haruka. You have an eye for these kinds of outfits.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane!
Try this shirt on!
I bet it'll look great on you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay... How do I look?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Absolutely adorable!
Not only does it look great on you, it goes perfectly with your current outfit!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, what if you wore these boots and this skirt too? We can pick out a full outfit for you right here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, An, what about you...?
Don't you want to try anything on?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm more of a street fashion girl.
I usually get what I wear down on Main Street instead of at malls like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I chose this store because it looked so cute, but maybe that wasn't such a good idea since An's with us...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we check out somewhere you like to go, An? I'm curious to see where you usually hang out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wanna go too!
We'd get to check out some clothes that we usually never get to see!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too...!
I'd like to see where you like to go as well, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Alright, let's go!
It's over this way!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So this is where you find what to wear...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it really is! It's like these clothes are all meant for you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Since we're here, why don't we all try on some stuff?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'll start with... Oh, this dress!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mirror, mirror on the wall♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Sort of...
Something just doesn't seem right...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
I think it looks really good on you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It may be because you're not used to seeing yourself in outfits like the one you're wearing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm...
You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I understand how you feel, Minori. I have a hard time picturing myself wearing all the cool outfits that An wears...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's like I'm not mature enough or something, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly! I feel the same way right now, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's like I'm not old enough to wear this, but want to find a way to fix that at the same time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You two really believe that?
I don't see anything wrong from where I'm standing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm with her.
I like what you've chosen and your current outfits also suit you both really well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so happy! I don't know what to say...! I promise to keep this outfit forever!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure they'll last that long...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, An, Haruka, do you see anything that you like?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sure, I see a few things.
How about you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not really sure since it's all so different compared to what I usually wear...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, how about this shirt?
It should be easy to work into what you usually wear, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa, that looks so cool...!
It suits her so well too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I agree completely!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you're all willing to say that much, then I guess I should try it on. Excuse me. I'd like to try this on...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna try some stuff on too. I'll take the stall next to yours!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is so exciting...!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ta-daah! All done!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't usually wear anything like this but... How do I look?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Kohane
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You look sooo amazing, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I love what you usually wear, but this, you look way too cool in that outfit! It's true! You really do look good in anything!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know you're exaggerating but... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You look really good too, An.
I wish I looked as good in that kind of outfit...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, this is one of my usual spots.
But I really appreciate the compliment, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And look at you, Haruka.
Talk about being stylish!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. This may take some getting used to, but it might be nice to wear something like this every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They look so incredible standing next to each other like this...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They look really cool, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everything okay, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, no, it's just...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You two look so cool in those outfits.
It's like you're models.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Me, a model?! No way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. But thank you for the compliment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Why do I feel this way?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What's this hazy feeling in my chest...?)
Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, thanks for waiting!
I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Welcome back, An.
I'm glad you found something you liked.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Alright, where to next?
It's past noon so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
How does lunch sound?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good! I'm starving!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, Minori, I did promise to tell you more about Haruka from way back when.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, please! I'd love to hear more about her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You promised to tell her more about me...? When did you two decide this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Minori seemed really jealous about me being your childhood friend...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I promised to tell her more about you from back then, but totally forgot last time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. Don't tell her too much, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I'd like to hear more about An from back then too...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I really want to know what you were like when you were little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, sure...
But I don't think I was that different, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-Is that a no?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's just, well...
Pretty embarrassing, you know?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. If you plan on telling them about me, then that makes your past fair game too, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess so.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, let's continue this after we find a place to eat.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!
Diner

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, where should I start?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Question! When did you two first meet?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Second grade, right?
When we were in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but we weren't really friends at that time...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But started talking more when were put into the same class again as fourth graders!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And that's when you became friends?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
“Friends” might not be the right word...
Our personalities were like oil and water.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah... We were in totally different cliques too, so we didn't really get along right off the bat.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really. But she really caught my attention during music class one day when we all had to sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Most of our classmates didn't take it seriously, but Haruka was different. She took that more seriously than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's hard to describe, but she wasn't like the others. It's like she really cared about music, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Haruka!
You've really always taken music seriously!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I wasn't doing anything special...
But I was serious about learning to sing properly since I wanted to be an idol...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's incredible...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I felt the same way back then, so I decided to try and out-sing Haruka by being louder than her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And it was hard not to notice.
I mean, every time our class sang together, your voice always overpowered everyone else's.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, was I that loud?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I can totally see you doing that, An.
Your voice has this natural echo to it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Thanks, but I feel embarrassed now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that did make me want to hear you sing more.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? That's a first!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, I've never told anyone that before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why didn't you tell me sooner?!
I would've loved to have heard that from you back then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm saying this now because I couldn't then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aww, I wish Haruka would praise me like that more...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not just current Haruka, but little Haruka too!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: M-Minori...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha!
You really can't help it, can you, Minori?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's adorable how much you admire Haruka, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I really do!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, you two became friends through music class?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that didn't happen until much later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. We still weren't really “friends” yet...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If anything, we were more like rivals.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Rivals...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we were playing basketball but on different teams this one time during P.E.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember that!
That was a really fun game.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It ended up being a tie, but we really started going at each other after that. That extended outside of basketball too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, from P.E. to music... Oh, remember when we had a contest to see who could eat lunch the fastest?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Haruka doing an eating contest?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, maybe I shouldn't be that surprised...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
I find it pretty hard to believe...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can see why.
I also remember challenging you to a studying contest and immediately turning me down...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because that would've been so boring!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I think I'm with An there...
I wouldn't stand a chance if schoolwork gets involved.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But I think I'd be willing to try if it's against you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh? Can I hold you to that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How about us, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Us, well... Eventually!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we really did have a lot of fun back then. We'd challenge each other and the loser would pick the next one...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And we never really got to determine who was better at basketball.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's right!
Who do you think would win right now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you be up for a free throw contest sometime?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! You're on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, they're so close...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. They really are.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, it's really interesting how they're so evenly matched at everything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An's always there to push me in the right direction, but their competitiveness is what drove their growth.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Almost like Haruka should be her...)
Diner

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for sharing so much with us, An, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I mean, you're welcome, but you're happy with just that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We really didn't tell you two that much, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For you, sure, but I got to learn more about a part of Haruka that I never knew about, so I'm really glad you told us all this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm filled with a mix of joy knowing more about little Haruka and sadness for not being able to witness her back then!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: H-Hold on, sadness?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. You're hilarious, Minori!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry, that's my phone...
I think it's my dad calling.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to use the restroom while you do that. Sorry, I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, we'll be here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They've really been friends forever, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, they really have!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm happy about learning so much about An's past, but that feeling from before is still lingering...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was so much fun.
Haruka being so competitive and taking singing so seriously back then explains so much...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm so jealous...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm jealous of not being her childhood friend, but also jealous of how they look so good together! It's unfair how well they mirror each other...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is that what I've been feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Seeing Haruka and An in this light...
Learning about how they see everything eye-to-eye...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Am I jealous...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I... I think I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you too?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, because An's always there to help me. I think a part of me wishes that I could challenge her the way Haruka does...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel like I should be doing that as her partner, and supporting her in every way I can...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I know... I know exactly how you feel!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wish I could help Haruka more, I wish I could work as hard as her and I wish I looked as good standing next to her as An does!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We may not be able to overcome the bond they've developed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that doesn't change how I feel about Haruka! It just makes me want to try even harder! More and more!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
I need to try harder to make sure An sees me as a partner she can be proud of!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ugh, Dad, why?
Making me pick stuff up on my way home...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, An, how was your call...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, Haruka, hey! Same old, same old, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, Minori's so cute!
Did you see the way her eyes sparkled while hearing about you from back then?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She has a habit of doing that, but I do appreciate the way she shows just how much she cares about me when we're together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You probably mean everything to her...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, stop...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But Kohane seemed just as interested in you, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm still not really sure what she'll get from hearing about my past.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Regardless, she seemed keen to find out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to learn more about Minori too. What she was like before we met or the things she used to do when she was little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
I think I'll ask Kohane the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'd like to know too.
We could conceivably sneak that conversation in today if we have time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we'll just have to play that by ear!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, you two.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About our next stop...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. We should start making our way towards PXL!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, it's already that late?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were there for a while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, I lost track of time back there. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Haruka!
We have a PXL Master right here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: PXL Master?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Master” might be a bit too far, but you can leave everything PXL-related to me...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to make sure you all get to have fun and enjoy yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! I'll be your personal escort, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Th-Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They seem pretty fired up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, they really must've been looking forward to this.
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Minori & An
rows.Line: We're here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is pretty exciting!
I've never been to PXL at night before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me neither! It's so different compared to normal!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we still have some time until the night show starts, so why don't we take a look around?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, Kohane, you're up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You do know a lot about PXL so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay! I'll do my best to make sure we all get to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You shouldn't have to try that hard, but I am looking forward to what you have in store for us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too. Take it away, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure, you can count on me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, something smells really sweet!
What could it be?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There should be a churro stand around here somewhere. Look, over there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
They're pretty famous and I've heard that their churros are really good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, their maple and strawberry churros are popular, but I really like their regular ones.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Toppings are nice and all, but the dough they use for their churros is so good. That's kind of why I like their plain old churros.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
B-But you can get whatever you like!
Everything they have here is really good so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You've had everything here?!
That's incredible, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a hard time saying no to their limited edition and seasonal churros.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, that's really interesting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it might be fun to do a stream where we go around the park and talk about why PXL is such a wonderful place.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, great idea!
That means you gotta have Kohane on as your guest.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we'll definitely be needing you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay, I'm getting nervous already, but I'll try my best...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get some of those churros Kohane was talking about and check out more stuff!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we go on the Ferris wheel? It's a really beautiful view from the top.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds awesome! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, that does sound nice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks...!
Alright, it's this way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That was really worth it.
Such a clear sky too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm glad it's so nice out today. You could really see for miles and miles.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And it really is nice to ride the Ferris wheel every once in a while! That thing goes up so high!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You could see everything too! All the show stages, rides and attractions, but from a really different angle!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm glad you guys liked it so much...! I genuinely do love the view this Ferris wheel gives you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I actually recommend going on it when you first arrive at the park and just before you leave. By doing that, you get to see two different sides of the park.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Two different sides?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You might see everything one way when your day starts, but then see it completely differently just as your visit is coming to a close.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you mean!
It's a chance to reminisce about any shows you saw or rides you went on while seeing everything one last time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...!
So we'd see the park in a different light as well if we come back later, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. It might be nice to go on it if we have time.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Is there anything you want to go on, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Me? How about...?
A roller coaster.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-Whaaat...?!
H-Haruka, you like roller coasters?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do. Especially the anticipation you feel when you're going up the ramp and the rush you get from each drop.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...? I never expected to hear that from you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What do I do...? I really don't like thrill rides...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But making Haruka worry about me after forcing myself to go on one would be bad too... Maybe I should just wait instead...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Minori?
If roller coasters aren't your thing then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah. Thanks, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um, Haruka.
I don't think...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, a roller coaster sounds awesome!
Let's go, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure, let's!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'll go too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? A-Are you sure, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah! I'll be fine!
Please, let me come with you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. You don't have to ask!
Come on, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're welcome, and I'm glad you decided to join us. I was under the impression that you didn't really like thrill rides.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haha...
No, I love them! I'll be fine!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You do?!
Hehe. More than meets the eye, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (You're not forcing yourself to do this, are you, Minori...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, Kohane, show us a roller coaster that you think we'd like!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay! This way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're almost at the top!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I can never get enough of this building anticipation.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Are you sure you're okay, Minori?
You've gone completely pale...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm okay...
But maybe I should've waited instead...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, we're about to crest over!
This is gonna be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? W-Wait...!
No...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nooooo...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I don't feel so good...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you okay, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay!
Just a little light-headed...
Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess that means you're not...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We should get you some water.
Kohane, is there a vending machine around here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, the closest one should be...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, really. I-I'm okay, honest... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's okay, Minori.
Just sit right here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm fine, really!
I'll feel better after I drink a little water...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I saw some being sold over there! Be right back!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
There she goes...
Is she gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Haruka's worried sick about me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can't believe I forced myself to go on that thing and troubled her just so I can be there next to her. What am I doing...?)
Is that you, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Airi? Shizuku?
What are you two doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After we last spoke, we managed to get everything together for our stream quicker than expected, so we decided to come and see the night show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Luka and the others are here too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe♪ Hello, Minori♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
L-Luka!
And Rin...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Don't forget me!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We asked Airi and Shizuku, and they agreed to letting us tag along. We've all really been looking forward to seeing this night show♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's great.
Hehe. I hope you guys like it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, Minori, where are Haruka and the others? Weren't you supposed to be with them today?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You don't seem as cheerful as you usually do... Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, well... I started feeling a little sick after riding a roller coaster and came to buy some water...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You went on a roller coaster?
Why?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-Because...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now I see...
You wanted to find a way to be more like this childhood friend of hers, but everything backfired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She looks so cool standing next to Haruka and she knows all about Haruka's childhood. They're like mirror images of each other in some ways.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Until now, I was doing everything I could to be able to stand next to her like that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't realize that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I don't think you need to try so hard.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: From my point of view, you're already able to stand proudly next to her.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I agree with Shizuku.
But if you still feel bothered by this...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Why not talk to Haruka about what you're feeling right now?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Tell her this...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. Tell her that you want to learn more about her and be there next to her moving forward.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But that sounds so selfish!
I'd be asking way too much of her...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh? I believe the opposite.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
If someone ever told me that, it'd make me really happy knowing that they really care about me♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Just think about it, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Is Haruka the kind of person who dislikes interacting with her fans or talking to them?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, she isn't like that at all! She even told me that she still has all the fan letters she's ever received!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <See?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <On top of that, you're a valued friend. Doesn't that mean she'd be more than willing to hear you out?>>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And I'm sure she'll try to find a way to help you out.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I'm sure you know that better than anyone else already. Right, Minori?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah♪ I think so too♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys might be right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You can do it, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...!
I really don't know how this is gonna go, but I'll do my best to try and tell her!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'm sure you will♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you too, Airi, Shizuku!
Hehe. Sorry for making you both help me like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. We're just glad you're back to being your usual self.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please feel free to say so again if something is bothering you. I'd be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, I will!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Haruka?!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I got worried and decided to go looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hold on... Airi? Shizuku?
Why are you two here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We came to see the night show, together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Together...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's what you meant...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! And I feel all better now thanks to them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's good to hear.
Please, tell the others “hi” for me and that I hope they enjoy everything.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And thank you for helping Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Momoi and Hinomori are here too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we literally just bumped into them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What are the odds?
And I'm glad you feel better now, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so sorry for making you all worry about me like that...! But I feel fine now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...!
But no more pushing yourself like that, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know. Why don't we take a break by the big fountain?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's a nice, big bench where we can sit while we wait for the night show to start.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice idea, Kohane!
Mind leading the way?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sure!
Let's go, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How do you feel, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A lot better now!
My legs feel less shaky too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, you should be all right by the time the night show starts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks! But I still feel terrible about keeping you guys from going on any other rides...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
It's fun just watching everything too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. I genuinely had a lot of fun visiting the park with all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, there's a Phenny hidden around here, so I was hoping to show it to you guys.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A hidden Phenny...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, they're these objects and designs that are hidden all throughout Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For example... Oh, the foot of that lamp. You can find some inside restaurants and on top of gates too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, those!
I've seen some sites that show you where they all are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I look for them sometimes too...
But I didn't know that there was one by the fountain. You know so much about PXL, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, I've still only found about 90% of what I've seen online.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What?! You've found that many of them?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hidden Phennys, huh?
Talk about a blast from the past!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I remember us trying to look for them when we came here for a field trip during elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Our entire class decided to look for them together and checked every part of the park we could.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we didn't find that many in the end.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We had to rush back to meet up with everyone too, but it was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I only vaguely remember where some of them were.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same. I mean, it's been an eternity since elementary school...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, hold on. I think I still remember where the last one I found was...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The one below the clock?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that! Wow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One of Haruka's childhood memories... I'd like to see it too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then, let's go check it out!
I can lead us there this time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It should be right around here... Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's gone...
It was here, right?
Or are we in the wrong spot?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They didn't take it down, did they...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, maybe they did.
There were a lot of renovations going on lately so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, An, let's keep looking for that clock a little more!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
I might be able to help too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
But... Do you really think we'll find it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I haven't heard much talk about any hidden Phennys being removed so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, can you describe to me that clock you saw?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Um, it was green and pretty tall.
Kinda retro too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh, I think I've seen it before. I'm pretty sure I took a photo of it too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is it this...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, Kohane, it's this...!
This is where we found that Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Kohane!
We should head over and find it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: F-Found it! Over there!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're right...!
It's the clock we saw during elementary school. It hasn't changed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That means the Phenny you were talking about should still be there!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
True.
It should be right around...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Here! Haruka, I found it!
Look, it's Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. This hasn't changed at all either since then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's so cool!
I was worried that we'd never actually find it for a second there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so glad this Phenny was still there, you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, and it's all thanks to you, Kohane! You put those smiles on their faces!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, isn't the show starting soon...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! We need to hurry!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone, this way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa... It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Isn't it amazing, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, An, look...! A Phenny hologram! That's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You never change, huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, I never imagined us becoming friends to the point of going to an amusement park together like this when we first met.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I know, right?
And seeing the night show like this on top of that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You never know what life's gonna throw at you, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They seem like they're really enjoying themselves...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It seems so natural for them to be together like this...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Not only that, Haruka and An know so much about each other already. They look like they're having so much fun when they're together...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I don't know nearly as much about An as Haruka does. I really wish I did...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm happy as long as An's happy...)
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The night show was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It really was! It was so amazing too when they cast their spell over us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This may've been because of all the illuminations, but all the rides and attractions seemed a little different too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, what if we saw the night show while riding the Ferris wheel next time?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That sounds incredible!
Imagine what it'll look like from way up there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We should all see it together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
S-Sure...!
It'd be fun to see it with you, An.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But for now, let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay.
Thanks for inviting us out today, Kohane, Minori! I had a blast!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too. That was super duper fun!
And I got to hear all about Haruka's past...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not sure you need to highlight that part...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm glad I got to hear that as well. It's clear now just how much you both mean to each other.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I hope we can keep hanging out together like this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course!
Again, thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be going now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Kohane, can you stick around just a little bit longer?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, okay...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting me out today, Minori. I had a really incredible time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you. And sorry for being such a bother today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Why are you apologizing, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because I feel like I'm the reason you didn't feel well today. It's like I made you do some things that you didn't want to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You didn't make me but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
About those stories you told us...
You know, when you and An first met?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It dawned on me that I really know nothing about you, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Uhh, I mean... When it comes to Haruka Kiritani the idol, I probably know more than anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I learned today that I really don't know anything about Haruka the girl...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How you like roller coasters, how you look amazing in really cool clothes and how competitive you are...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I learned about all those things for the first time today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I admire you so much and get to hang out with you like this, but there's still so much that I don't know about you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: On top of that, I'm so jealous of An for having known you for so long, and I felt this enormous gap between us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I convinced myself to ride that roller coaster today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Hehe. So that's what happened.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I... I'm so sorry!
And I'm being a huge bother right now too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please, just try to forget about everything...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I won't. How can I forget about something that makes me feel so happy?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Happy...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, happy.
Because you're making a real effort to get to know me as a person and not as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're making an effort not just as my fan, but because you want to be my friend...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can't thank you enough for that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, really. Thank you for being so honest with me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But no more forcing yourself into doing things that you don't like, okay? I like you just the way you are, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
I promise to keep learning as much as I can about you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And one day, I'm gonna know more about you than anybody else!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
I hope I get to know more about you too, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
Thanks, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks again for inviting me out today! I had so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And that night show at the end!
It was my first time seeing it, but it was so pretty and spectacular!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I had fun too!
I was hoping that we'd get to see it together for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And they change what they do periodically, so we should come back when we get a chance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Is that true?!
Hit me up when that happens!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But... Is something bothering you, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... You seemed a bit off today, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When we were trying on clothes and even during the night show, you had this look on your face...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It was nothing, really.
That had to do with how you look good in just about anything...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And how much fun it looked like you were having today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know that I was able to have that much fun today because of you, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
One, you showed us around the park.
Two, you were so kind and thoughtful.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, you helped us find the Phenny hiding below the clock!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I just happened to remember that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's just one example out of the entire bunch!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So thank you, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And remember what you said about the Ferris wheel? About seeing a different side of the park?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wanna go on it together to cap things off?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: J-Just us?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Our last hurrah to finish off an awesome day!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The Ferris wheel's over that way, so we'll have to walk for a bit...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's totally fine!
We can look at all the illuminations along the way!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, what's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, that fountain...
Something seems different about it now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Different how...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look! The center of the fountain under Phenny's feet! It's like there's something there, but not. Can you see it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
Was there a Phenny hiding there this whole time?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I never knew that...!
I'm not sure if anyone else knows about this one!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! That means we're the ones who discovered it first, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we make this our hidden Phenny?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ours...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it'll be our special spot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's amazing how bright An's smile is.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (A part of me did feel a little sad throughout the day, but I guess I didn't really need to...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I want to keep being by her side...
I want to keep seeing that wonderful smile.)
